comment: Inputs release builds take from other repositories, each pinned to a tag checked against its revision (scripts/pinned-checkout.sh). libs-back has its own lock file, with its patches (packaging/linux/libs-back). Local builds can still point at their own trees with ADWAITA_THEME, GNUSTEP_PACKAGER and TOOLS_XCTEST_ROOT; release-linux.sh --publish refuses a tree that is not at its pin. See docs/packaging.md.

gnustep-packager.comment: The merge of #57 (the reusable workflow checks out its own commit). No tag yet: move to v0.1.1 when it is cut.
